description: Kamaji is the Hosted Control Plane Manager for Kubernetes.

Kanidm: an identity management server with users, groups, OAuth2/OIDC, LDAPS, passkeys and a web UI, always on TLS. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, nonroot, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

Semaphore UI: a web UI and API for running Ansible, Terraform/OpenTofu and shell tasks, with the admin and encryption keys generated at install. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, nonroot, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.
